provenance.description: QR Code Model 2 vectors for GS1 QR Code (FNC1 in first position, ]Q3) and QR Code carrying a GS1 Digital Link URI (]Q1): tables, gs1-barcode-engine unit test matrices, symbols sampled from GS1 publications, derived symbols cross-checked with bwip-js and zxing-wasm, structure hashes for all 160 version/level combinations, and mask penalty examples.
sources: gs1-barcode-engine master 289c899 (2024-09-26), src/c-lib/qr.c UNIT_TESTS (test_qr_QR_encode, test_qr_QR_fixtures, test_qr_QR_versions) and src/c-lib/scandata.c
bwip-js 4.11.4 (BWIPP 2026-05-28) and zxing-wasm 3.1.5 as oracles; a throwaway scratch encoder/decoder written for this research
provenance.format: rows: one string per module row, "X" dark and " " light, no quiet zone (QR needs 4 modules). input: transmitted data without the AIM identifier; for element strings, FNC1 separators are U+001D. scan: AIM identifier + input. segments: decoded segment list in order, count is the character count indicator value (alphanumeric counts include the doubled "%" and each FNC1 "%"). dataCodewords: hex, before interleaving; interleavedCodewords: hex, final order (data then EC, no remainder bits). mask: the mask pattern reference 0..7 from the format information. penaltyMask.bwipp: mask the BWIPP/gs1-barcode-engine penalty selects for these codewords; penaltyMask.isoLiteral: mask an ISO-literal penalty (format and version information drawn, 1011101 with 4 light modules, outside counts as light) selects. structure: sha256 of the rows of encode("HELLO1", { version, level }) as "0"/"1" strings joined by "\n" (equal to bwip-js qrcode with fixedeclevel). versionInfo and formatInfo bits: integers, most significant bit first in reading order as in the note.
provenance.licence: gs1-barcode-engine vectors: Apache-2.0 (test-only use); bwip-js: MIT
